The license also prohibits any photography or recording by visitors, so we'll need signage or enforcement measures at the stations. And finally, the exact credit line 'Music licensed from Harborlight Editions' must be used. I haven't amended the exhibition packet yet since the license arrived after it was circulated, but these conditions need to be added before the plan is approved.
